notes.title: 1.1 Update
notes.content:
Extra Functionality

Drag Multi Select: you can now either hold LMB + RMB or Shift + LMB to drag the mouse over any dice you want to quickly select.
Auto Save Layouts: Layouts are saved automatically when exiting Add or Remove Mode. (Can be disabled in Settings)
Move dice in Add Mode by clicking and dragging. Move Mode has been removed.
Remove all dice in Remove Mode by clicking and holding on the trash icon
Quick Switch between Add and Remove Mode.
Remember Layouts: whichever layout you had selected last will be loaded first on launch
All Dice Now Free:  money is fake
